The '''Shawda Ubb''', or '''Ubb''', were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. They were small [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]]&mdash;each stood from 0.3 to one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall&mdash;with long [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and round, squat torsos. Their green and yellow skin was moist and elastic and covered in warts. Shawda Ubb were adapted to their moist, swampy [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and felt physically weakened and emotionally withdrawn in dryer environments. They defended themselves by spitting a paralyzing venom, which could immobilize a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized [[Mammal/Legends|mammal]] for up to fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. On Manpha, Shawda Ubb ate uncooked swamp [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and raw [[Fish/Legends|fish]]; they avoided cooked and processed food.

In their ancient history, the Shawda Ubb lived as marsh [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], however, most Shawda Ubb lived simple, low-technological lifestyles in small [[City/Legends|settlements]], which were connected to one another via a network of [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. Many of these towns and villages pumped crude [[petroleum]] from the swamps and sold it to [[Oil/Legends|oil]] companies located in Manpha's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Shanpan]]. There, the crude petroleum was processed into [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] for export from the planet's [[Shanpan|only spaceport]]. Other communities sold raw foods for export. Shawda Ubb were largely conservative creatures, and few left their home community. Leaving the planet was even rarer, although emigration was not unheard of. The Shawda Ubb [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon]], better known as Rappertunie, joined the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] as a [[Growdi Harmonique/Legends|growdi]] player during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:ShawdaUbb-AlienEncounters.png|thumb|left|Shawda Ubb were comfortable with standard technology, such as datapads, but preferred simpler fare.]]
Shawda Ubb, also known as Ubb,<ref name="SWTSBSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> were diminutive, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] with [[Frog/Legends|frog]]-like bodies. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] had long, spindly [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]<ref name="CSWE III 145" /> that ended in three splayed digits each;<ref name="AE" /> the toes also sported [[Color/Legends|yellow]] claws. A bony shoulder blade jutted from the top of each arm.<ref name="Hasbro" /> The lanky appendages contrasted with the round, squat trunk typical of the species, with its prominent paunch,<ref name="NEGAS" /> navel, [[Breast/Legends|breasts]], and nipples.<ref name="Hasbro" /> Generally, Shawda Ubb ranged in size from 0.3 to one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] in height.<ref name="height" /> Members of the species were covered in warty,<ref name="Hasbro" /> speckled skin that changed from a greenish-gray on the back, head, and limbs to a light yellow-green on the underbelly.<ref name="CSWE III 145" /> Some members of the species sported striped patterns on the forearms. A crest ran along the back of the head and down the neck and back, thickening as it traveled downward. Another thin crest ran along each forearm.<ref name="Hasbro" />

The small, fat Shawda Ubb head<ref name="ROTJJN">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> featured a blunt snout with a wide [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and a thin lower lip. The two, side-mounted [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were situated on the sides of the snout above heavy bags, and under heavy lids and thick brow ridges<ref name="Hasbro" /> that acted to keep rain from running into the Shawda Ubb's eyes.<ref name="AE" /> Blue was one possible color for the irises of these visual organs.<ref name="Hasbro" /> Shawda Ubb were perceptive beings with a keen aptitude for observation.<ref name="AE" /><ref name="Humans">The comparison is to the statistics for the Human species given in ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''; Humans have average attribute ranges according to the rules.</ref>

As per their amphibious nature, the Shawda Ubb thrived best in moist environments.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Their tough, elastic skin<ref name="CSWE III 145" /> was naturally damp,<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|rappertunie|Rappertunie}}.</ref> but in dry environments, a Shawda Ubb had to keep their skin moist, lest it dry out and crack. In fact, extreme heat and dryness caused Shawda Ubb to tire quickly, making them lethargic<ref name="NEGAS" /> and preventing them from operating at their full capacity. Arid conditions also forced a Shawda Ubb to drink prodigious amounts of [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="FF MAX10">{{FactFile|75|MAX 7-10|Max Rebo Band}}.</ref>

Although they lacked an imposing physique and ran relatively slowly<ref name="AE" />&mdash;moving about half the speed of an average [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Humans" />&mdash;members of the species possessed a natural, [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] venom that they were able to employ as a defensive measure; a Shawda Ubb used the substance by spitting it on an attacker.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> The venom could paralyze a Human-sized [[Mammal/Legends|mammal]] for fifteen standard [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

Shawda Ubb had two [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], male and female. Despite their navels, members of the species hatched from [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. Females laid between one and three eggs each [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Typically only one of these was fertilized to hatch into a [[Youngling/Legends|child]].<ref name="AE" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:Shawda_Ubb_DB_side.jpg|thumb|right|upright|The Shawda Ubb created several indigenous instruments, such as the growdi.]]
In their most ancient days, the Shawda Ubb lived as [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], roaming the marshes of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]], and using their venom to paralyze prey and allow the pursuers to go in for the [[Death/Legends|kill]]. As the species advanced technologically, they took to [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] with one another and purchasing most of their food.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> The species' diet consisted primarily of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] and marsh [[Grass/Legends|grasses]]; they preferred to eat their food raw.<ref name="AE" />

Shawda Ubb were suspicious of strangers and were willing to defend themselves with their paralytic venom if the need arose.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> Accordingly, they preferred to live in settlements that were small enough to allow each inhabitant to recognize the other denizens. Such inclinations encouraged the founding and habitation of hundreds of thousands of small [[City/Legends|towns]] and villages interspersed throughout the marshes of their homeworld's lone landmass.<ref name="AE" /> These settlements were often situated far from their nearest neighbor, which left their inhabitants reliant on visitors from afar to relate news of broader regional interest.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> Although they generally eschewed travel,<ref name="FF MAX10" /> Shawda Ubb employed a wide array of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to taxi themselves from one population center to another. Manpha had one [[Shanpan|spaceport]], located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city, [[Shanpan]].<ref name="AE" /> The city handled all interstellar trade and sported a bevy of [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] to cater to off-worlders.<ref name="SWTSBSE" />

Manpha possessed rich deposits of [[petroleum]] that constantly bubbled up into the waters of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] swamps.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> The Shawda Ubb economy was based on small-scale petroleum extraction and refining; community [[Oil/Legends|oil]] cooperatives pumped fossil fuels from below the planetary surface and stored it in barrels to be sold to national oil companies headquartered in Shanpan. The factories, in turn, processed the oil to produce [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] for sale to off-world traders. Food processing was another important industry for the species; the Shawda Ubb preference for raw food prejudiced them toward selling uncooked victuals.<ref name="AE" /> These enterprises provided a decent standard of living to most members of the species<ref name="FF MAX10" /> and afforded the Shawda Ubb access to [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]]-standard technology. Nevertheless, the species had little aptitude for tasks that involved [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] or technical equipment, and they preferred simpler goods.<ref name="AE" />

Shawda Ubb were known for their indigenous [[Music/Legends|musical]] instruments. For instance, the [[Growdi Harmonique/Legends|growdi]]&mdash;also known as the growdi water organ<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and the growdi harmonique<ref name="WWITMRB">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref>&mdash;resembled a combination of [[Flute/Legends|flute]] and [[Water organ/Legends|water organ]]. A hose ran from the flute-like section to the base, upon which the player sat. The perch exuded moisture, which helped vivify the [[Musician/Legends|musician]] sitting there<ref name="CSWE III 79">{{CSWECite|III|79|Rappertunie}}</ref> and keep him or her cool.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The instrument came in both electronic and acoustic variants.<ref name="SWTSBSE" />

Members of the species had two-part names, although their appellations were difficult for non&ndash;Shawda Ubb to pronounce. For this reason, they often took nicknames to use with [[Alien/Legends|aliens]].<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> For example, the Shawda Ubb musician [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon]] was widely known as Rappertunie.<ref name="CSWE III 79" />

==History==
The Shawda Ubb evolved on the humid, marshy world Manpha. Although they developed from [[Bird/Legends|avian]] stock, the species eventually became amphibious, adapted to the planet's wet ecosystem.<ref name="FF MAX10" /> After developing sentience, early Shawda Ubb lived as subsistence hunters. Their technology eventually progressed to the point that they established small settlements and took to trading with one another instead.<ref name="SWTSBSE" />

The [[Manpha system/Legends|Manpha system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}.</ref> became integrated into the greater [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] at some point between [[3000 BBY|3000]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The world was eventually reached by the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and became part of the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Shawda Ubb's homeworld was located outside both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Nagai–Tof War|Nagai invasion]] of the galaxy, the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the site of a [[Battle of the Manpha system|battle]], which the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] invaders won. Circa [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Manpha lay within a region of the galaxy with an average population of ten to one hundred million sentients per [[Star/Legends|star]] system. In [[137 ABY]], the world fell within territory claimed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] as his [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EA" />

==Shawda Ubb in the galaxy==
[[File:Shawda_Ubb_concert_AE.jpg|thumb|left|Although Shawda Ubb rarely left their home settlement, a few did roam the galaxy as musicians.]]
As unabashed homebodies, the Shawda Ubb rarely left their home settlements, let alone Manpha. Their small stature made members of the species vulnerable in a galaxy geared more toward larger beings, and Shawda Ubb were easy prey for [[Diet/Legends|predators]] on other planets.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> Nevertheless, the species was not unknown in the wider galaxy; in fact, [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an eatery on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], offered a [[Shawda Clubb sandwich]] on its menu.<ref name="DD 4">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}.</ref>

Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon was one of the rare Shawda Ubb with an unbridled urge to travel.<ref name="CSWE III 79" /> From his youth, he was a gifted musician who played several instruments,<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''.</ref> and he wandered from settlement to settlement, playing instruments and spreading news to earn his keep.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> The itinerant minstrel eventually set his sights on Shanpan, the planet's largest population center, and saved his money to afford transit to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] city. He reached it after entering young adulthood.<ref name="FF MAX10" />

In Shanpan, Tivtotolon encountered off-worlders for the first time and adopted the stage name Rappertunie.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> He played with a string of bands before he was finally discovered by a visiting musical group known as the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]. They invited Rappertunie to join them, and in the belief that being a member of their group would let him see the galaxy, the Shawda Ubb agreed.<ref name="FF MAX10" /> Soon, Rappertunie found himself performing as a backup musician<ref name="BTM" /> for [[Max Rebo/Legends|Rebo's]] group in the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|court]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on the desert planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> Rappertunie despised the gig; the world was hot and dry, and it involved little travel. The diminutive musician gained his freedom when Jabba's [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] exploded during a [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|skirmish]]&mdash;when Rebo and his lead singer, [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]], returned to the palace, Rappertunie rejoined them and left Tatooine.<ref name="FF MAX10" /> Rappertunie and Snootles formed a duo for a time, but their efforts sold poorly. He eventually took up [[Computer/Legends|computer]] engineering for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-production company [[Rebaxan Columni/Legends|Rebaxan Columni]] as part of the team responsible for the design of upgrades for the [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6 series]].<ref name="WWITMRB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rappertunie_puppet_in_production.jpg|thumb|right|Rappertunie the Shawda Ubb was a full-size puppet created for the ''Special Edition'' of ''Return of the Jedi''.]]
A frog-like puppet was created as part of the [[List of changes in Star Wars re-releases|changes]] to the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']] of the [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] film during its [[1997]] re-release. Concept art for the character was drawn by [[George Hull]]; an early design resembles the final creature except for its long tail, which was removed from the final puppet.<ref name="AoROTJ">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> The crew referred to the character as "Jedi Rapper" during production. The puppet was digitally added to scenes of the Max Rebo Band performing in Jabba's Palace as part of a general change to replace the original song, "[[Lapti Nek/Legends|Lapti Nek]]," with a song called "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]."<ref name="DB" /> As part of Jabba's court, Rappertunie appears as a background character in several images of the palace, as in ''[[Escape from Jabba's Palace]]'', a children's book written by [[Jay Rudko]].

Both the musician character and his species received names&mdash;Rappertunie and Shawda Ubb, respectively&mdash;in the ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a 1997 sourcebook for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]]. The volume's writers also provided information about Shawda Ubb biology, culture, and society. Game statistics in the book allow players of the [[roleplaying game]] to portray Shawda Ubb characters; they receive bonuses to actions taken in moist environments, but penalties to those in dry ones.<ref name="SWTSBSE" /> The [[1998]] West End Games book ''[[Alien Encounters]]'' reprints these values and expands on the species' background.<ref name="AE" />
